installer.brand.slogan: A container for every way you work.
installer.home.title: One step to install, then hand it over.
installer.home.sub: It doesn’t dictate how you work — it holds whatever your work becomes.
installer.home.foot: By continuing you agree to the License · MIT
installer.opt.filemenu: Add “Open with LinkDesk” to the file context menu
installer.opt.dirmenu: Add “Open with LinkDesk” to the directory context menu
installer.opt.editor: Register LinkDesk as an editor for supported file types
installer.opt.path: Add to PATH (effective after restarting terminals)
installer.progress.step1: Extract files (app + bundled plugins + AI manual)
installer.progress.step2: Register file associations (add to the “Open with” list)
installer.progress.step3: Write system entries (shortcuts · context menu · PATH)
installer.finish.title: All set.
installer.error.title: Installation didn’t finish.
installer.error.sub: Not enough disk space — the target drive needs at least 1 GB, only 412 MB free.
installer.version.body.same: This package is the same version ({version}). Installing again overwrites the existing files — your settings and data are untouched.
installer.version.body.older: This machine has {installed}, and this package is the older {incoming}. Continuing replaces the newer version with the older one.
installer.path.err.chars: The path contains characters Windows doesn’t allow ( < > " | ? * ).
installer.path.err.length: The path is too long — pick a shorter location.
installer.path.err.root: Pick a folder, not a whole drive.
installer.path.err.absolute: Enter a full path with a drive letter (for example C:\Apps\LinkDesk).
installer.path.err.write: This location isn’t writable (no permission, or the path is in use). Try another one.
installer.uninstall.confirm.title: Uninstall LinkDesk?
installer.uninstall.running.title: LinkDesk is running
installer.uninstall.running.sub: Uninstalling will continue after LinkDesk closes; unsaved workspaces go through its save flow first.
installer.uninstall.running.timeout: Waited 10 seconds and LinkDesk is still running. It may be sitting on a save dialog — close its window yourself, or choose “Later”.
installer.uninstall.progress.step2: Clean system entries (context menu · editor registration)
installer.uninstall.progress.step3: Restore PATH (exact match only — never touches your edits)
installer.uninstall.finish.title: Uninstalled.
installer.uninstall.finish.sub: Thanks for using LinkDesk — until we meet again.
